# Extract detritivore distributions
```{r}
det.list <- lvl3.categorical %>% 
  filter(grepl("detritivore",traitValue) == T) 
det.list <- arctic.taxa.list %>% 
  filter(taxaName %in% det.list$Species)

det.hydrobios <- hydrobios %>% 
  mutate(TAXON_ID = str_trim(str_remove(TAXON_ID, "\\bspp\\.")),
         TAXON_ID = str_trim(str_remove(TAXON_ID, "\\bsp\\."))) %>%
  filter(TAXON_ID %in% det.list$verbatimScientificName)

# vertical distributions of detritivores
det.total.abundance <- det.hydrobios %>% 
  group_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, DEPLOYMENT_TIME_START,
           SAMPLING_NET_ID, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH, volume_filtered_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mid_sample_depth = (MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH + MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH)/2) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START)) %>% 
  mutate(station_year = paste(STATION_NAME, year)) %>% 
  filter(station_year %in% uvp_net_match$station_year) %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuktitut, reg.inuk,
                     BOTTOM_DEPTH:LONGITUDE)) %>% 
  arrange(mid_sample_depth)


ggplot(det.total.abundance, 
       aes(group = station_year, x = abundance_m3, y = mid_sample_depth,
                 color = station_year)) +
  # geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, scale = "free_y")
```
